
That should fix the “starts near the end / plays then stops” behavior.

For the glowing song list, add these imports:

```kotlin
import android.graphics.Color
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter
import android.widget.TextView
```

Then replace your whole `showSongList()` with this:

```kotlin
private fun showSongList() {
    val controller = mediaController ?: return
    val album = currentAlbum()

    val songTitles = album.songs.map { it.title }

    val adapter = object : ArrayAdapter<String>(
        this,
        android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1,
        songTitles
    ) {
        override fun getView(position: Int, convertView: View?, parent: ViewGroup): View {
            val view = super.getView(position, convertView, parent) as TextView

            val isCurrentSong =
                position == controller.currentMediaItemIndex

            view.textSize = 16f
            view.setPadding(32, 24, 32, 24)

            if (isCurrentSong) {
                view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 140, 40))
                view.setShadowLayer(18f, 0f, 0f, Color.rgb(255, 90, 0))
                view.setBackgroundColor(Color.argb(55, 255, 100, 0))
                view.text = "▶  ${songTitles[position]}"
            } else {
                view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 218, 200))
                view.setShadowLayer(0f, 0f, 0f, Color.TRANSPARENT)
                view.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(18, 15, 14))
                view.text = songTitles[position]
            }

            return view
        }
    }

    AlertDialog.Builder(this)
        .setTitle(album.title)
        .setAdapter(adapter) { dialog, which ->
            controller.seekToDefaultPosition(which)
            controller.play()
            playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
            dialog.dismiss()
        }
        .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
        .show()
}
```

That gives you the orange “currently playing” glow immediately. After that works, we can darken the main buttons/background next.

```kotlin
        nextBtn = findViewById(R.id.nextBtn)
        shuffleBtn = findViewById(R.id.shuffleBtn)
        repeatBtn = findViewById(R.id.repeatBtn)

        webView.webViewClient = WebViewClient()
        webView.webChromeClient = WebChromeClient()

        val webSettings: WebSettings = webView.settings
        webSettings.javaScriptEnabled = true
        webSettings.domStorageEnabled = true
        webSettings.mediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture = true

        webView.loadUrl("https://lokiskingdom.com")

        webView.evaluateJavascript(
            """
            document.querySelectorAll('audio').forEach(a => {
                a.autoplay = false;
                a.pause();
            });
            """.trimIndent(),
            null
        )

        val sessionToken = SessionToken(
            this,
            android.content.ComponentName(
                this,
                MusicService::class.java
            )
        )

        val controllerFuture =
            MediaController.Builder(this, sessionToken)
                .buildAsync()

        controllerFuture.addListener({

            mediaController = controllerFuture.get()

            loadAlbumIntoController(0, autoPlay = false)
            setupButtons()

        }, MoreExecutors.directExecutor())
    }

    private fun currentAlbum(): Album {
        return MusicCatalog.albums[currentAlbumIndex]
    }

    private fun loadAlbumIntoController(
        albumIndex: Int,
        autoPlay: Boolean
    ) {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return

        if (albumIndex < 0 || albumIndex >= MusicCatalog.albums.size) return

        currentAlbumIndex = albumIndex

        val album = MusicCatalog.albums[currentAlbumIndex]

        val mediaItems =
            album.songs.map { song ->
                MediaItem.fromUri(r2Base + song.file)
            }

        controller.stop()
        controller.clearMediaItems()

        // Force every newly selected album to start at track 0.
        controller.setMediaItems(mediaItems, 0, 0L)

        controller.prepare()
        controller.repeatMode = repeatMode

        albumsBtn.text = album.title

        if (autoPlay) {
            controller.play()
            playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
        } else {
            playPauseBtn.text = "Play"
        }
    }

    private fun setupButtons() {

        albumsBtn.setOnClickListener {
            showAlbumList()
        }

        songListBtn.setOnClickListener {
            showSongList()
        }

        prevBtn.setOnClickListener {
            mediaController?.seekToPreviousMediaItem()
        }

        nextBtn.setOnClickListener {
            mediaController?.seekToNextMediaItem()
        }

        playPauseBtn.setOnClickListener {
            val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

            if (controller.isPlaying) {
                controller.pause()
                playPauseBtn.text = "Play"
            } else {
                controller.play()
                playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
            }
        }

        shuffleBtn.setOnClickListener {
            val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

            controller.shuffleModeEnabled =
                !controller.shuffleModeEnabled

            shuffleBtn.text =
                if (controller.shuffleModeEnabled) {
                    "Shuffle On"
                } else {
                    "Shuffle"
                }
        }

        repeatBtn.setOnClickListener {
            val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

            repeatMode =
                when (repeatMode) {
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_OFF -> Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL -> Player.REPEAT_MODE_ONE
                    else -> Player.REPEAT_MODE_OFF
                }

            controller.repeatMode = repeatMode

            repeatBtn.text =
                when (repeatMode) {
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL -> "Repeat All"
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_ONE -> "Repeat One"
                    else -> "Repeat Off"
                }
        }
    }

    private fun showAlbumList() {
        val albumTitles =
            MusicCatalog.albums.map { it.title }.toTypedArray()

        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle("Select Album")
            .setItems(albumTitles) { dialog, which ->
                loadAlbumIntoController(which, autoPlay = true)
                dialog.dismiss()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun showSongList() {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return
        val album = currentAlbum()

        val songTitles = album.songs.map { it.title }

        val adapter = object : ArrayAdapter<String>(
            this,
            android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1,
            songTitles
        ) {
            override fun getView(
                position: Int,
                convertView: View?,
                parent: ViewGroup
            ): View {
                val view =
                    super.getView(position, convertView, parent) as TextView

                val isCurrentSong =
                    position == controller.currentMediaItemIndex

                view.textSize = 16f
                view.setPadding(32, 24, 32, 24)

                if (isCurrentSong) {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 140, 40))
                    view.setShadowLayer(
                        18f,
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        Color.rgb(255, 90, 0)
                    )
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.argb(55, 255, 100, 0))
                    view.text = "▶  ${songTitles[position]}"
                } else {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 218, 200))
                    view.setShadowLayer(
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        Color.TRANSPARENT
                    )
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(18, 15, 14))
                    view.text = songTitles[position]
                }

                return view
            }
        }

        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle(album.title)
            .setAdapter(adapter) { dialog, which ->
                controller.seekToDefaultPosition(which)
                controller.play()
                playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
                dialog.dismiss()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        mediaController?.release()
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    override fun onBackPressed() {
        if (webView.canGoBack()) {
            webView.goBack()
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            super.onBackPressed()
        }
    }
}
```

user
can we add a shuffle all as well without making a huge amount of problems for ourselves?
ChatGPT
Yes. Shuffle-all is manageable.

Cleanest simple version:

- normal shuffle = shuffle current album
- shuffle all = load every song from every album into one big Media3 playlist
- then enable shuffle
- start playback

It does mean the current `currentAlbum()` song list won’t match while in “all songs” mode, so we should treat it as a separate mode.

Add:

```kotlin
private var isShuffleAllMode = false
```

Then make a function:

```kotlin
private fun loadAllSongsShuffle() {
    val controller = mediaController ?: return

    val allSongs =
        MusicCatalog.albums.flatMap { album ->
            album.songs.map { song ->
                MediaItem.fromUri(r2Base + song.file)
            }
        }

    isShuffleAllMode = true

    controller.stop()
    controller.clearMediaItems()
    controller.setMediaItems(allSongs, 0, 0L)
    controller.shuffleModeEnabled = true
    controller.prepare()
    controller.play()

    albumsBtn.text = "All Albums"
    shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle All"
    playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
}
```

Then change your shuffle button behavior to cycle:

```kotlin
shuffleBtn.setOnClickListener {
    val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

    if (!controller.shuffleModeEnabled && !isShuffleAllMode) {
        controller.shuffleModeEnabled = true
        shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle Album"
    } else if (controller.shuffleModeEnabled && !isShuffleAllMode) {
        loadAllSongsShuffle()
    } else {
        isShuffleAllMode = false
        controller.shuffleModeEnabled = false
        loadAlbumIntoController(currentAlbumIndex, autoPlay = false)
        shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle"
    }
}
```

Cycle becomes:

```text
Shuffle → Shuffle Album → Shuffle All → Shuffle Off
```

Not too dangerous. The only thing to remember: when user selects a normal album, set:

```kotlin
isShuffleAllMode = false
```

inside `loadAlbumIntoController()`.

user
the wrong album and wrong songlist showing is actually a non-trivial problem, can it be resolved, any reason we can't just refresh the song / album room lists every time the song changes?
ChatGPT
Yes, it can be resolved — and you’re right: the app needs to update its idea of “current album/current song” whenever Media3 changes tracks.

The current issue is that `currentAlbumIndex` is manually tracked by your app, but in **Shuffle All**, Media3’s playlist is no longer the same as the selected album. So the UI can lie.

The proper fix is:

- create a real “play queue” list
- each queue item remembers its album index and song index
- when Media3 changes song, read `controller.currentMediaItemIndex`
- use that to update:
  - current album
  - current song
  - album button text
  - song list glow

So yes: add a Media3 listener:

```kotlin
controller.addListener(object : Player.Listener {
    override fun onMediaItemTransition(mediaItem: MediaItem?, reason: Int) {
        updateNowPlayingFromController()
    }
})
```

Then `updateNowPlayingFromController()` looks at the current queue item and refreshes the UI.

I would **not** just blindly rebuild all album/song lists constantly, because dialogs are temporary popup UI. Instead, keep the app’s source of truth synced, and when the song list opens, it will always show the correct current album/song.

So the answer is:

Yes, solvable.  
No, not dangerous.  
But we should fix it cleanly with queue metadata, not duct tape.

For shuffle-all, the song list should probably show either:

```text
All Albums — Current Shuffle Queue
```

or automatically switch the album button to the album of the currently playing song.

I’d recommend this behavior:

- Album button shows the real currently playing album
- Song list opens that album
- Current song glows correctly inside that album
- Shuffle All button still says `Shuffle All`

That will feel intelligent instead of confusing.

```kotlin
package com.example.lokis_kingdom

import android.app.AlertDialog
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.webkit.WebChromeClient
import android.webkit.WebSettings
import android.webkit.WebView
import android.webkit.WebViewClient
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.media3.common.MediaItem
import androidx.media3.common.Player
import androidx.media3.session.MediaController
import androidx.media3.session.SessionToken
import com.google.common.util.concurrent.MoreExecutors

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var webView: WebView

    private lateinit var albumsBtn: Button
    private lateinit var songListBtn: Button
    private lateinit var prevBtn: Button
    private lateinit var playPauseBtn: Button
    private lateinit var nextBtn: Button
    private lateinit var shuffleBtn: Button
    private lateinit var repeatBtn: Button

    private var mediaController: MediaController? = null
    private var repeatMode = Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL

    private var currentAlbumIndex = 0
    private var currentSongIndex = 0
    private var isShuffleAllMode = false

    private data class QueueSong(
        val albumIndex: Int,
        val songIndex: Int,
        val title: String,
        val file: String
    )

    private var currentQueue: List<QueueSong> = emptyList()

    private val r2Base =
        "https://pub-4ae7f49887bc46e9a03de6e38886b609.r2.dev/"

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)

        webView = findViewById(R.id.webView)

        albumsBtn = findViewById(R.id.albumsBtn)
        songListBtn = findViewById(R.id.songListBtn)
        prevBtn = findViewById(R.id.prevBtn)
        playPauseBtn = findViewById(R.id.playPauseBtn)
        nextBtn = findViewById(R.id.nextBtn)
        shuffleBtn = findViewById(R.id.shuffleBtn)
        repeatBtn = findViewById(R.id.repeatBtn)

        webView.webViewClient = WebViewClient()
        webView.webChromeClient = WebChromeClient()

        val webSettings: WebSettings = webView.settings
        webSettings.javaScriptEnabled = true
        webSettings.domStorageEnabled = true
        webSettings.mediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture = true

        webView.loadUrl("https://lokiskingdom.com")

        webView.evaluateJavascript(
            """
            document.querySelectorAll('audio').forEach(a => {
                a.autoplay = false;
                a.pause();
            });
            """.trimIndent(),
            null
        )

        val sessionToken = SessionToken(
            this,
            android.content.ComponentName(
                this,
                MusicService::class.java
            )
        )

        val controllerFuture =
            MediaController.Builder(this, sessionToken)
                .buildAsync()

        controllerFuture.addListener({
            mediaController = controllerFuture.get()

            mediaController?.addListener(object : Player.Listener {
                override fun onMediaItemTransition(
                    mediaItem: MediaItem?,
                    reason: Int
                ) {
                    updateNowPlayingFromController()
                }

                override fun onIsPlayingChanged(isPlaying: Boolean) {
                    playPauseBtn.text = if (isPlaying) "Pause" else "Play"
                }
            })

            loadAlbumIntoController(0, autoPlay = false)
            setupButtons()
        }, MoreExecutors.directExecutor())
    }

    private fun currentAlbum(): Album {
        return MusicCatalog.albums[currentAlbumIndex]
    }

    private fun makeAlbumQueue(albumIndex: Int): List<QueueSong> {
        val album = MusicCatalog.albums[albumIndex]

        return album.songs.mapIndexed { songIndex, song ->
            QueueSong(
                albumIndex = albumIndex,
                songIndex = songIndex,
                title = song.title,
                file = song.file
            )
        }
    }

    private fun makeAllSongsQueue(): List<QueueSong> {
        return MusicCatalog.albums.flatMapIndexed { albumIndex, album ->
            album.songs.mapIndexed { songIndex, song ->
                QueueSong(
                    albumIndex = albumIndex,
                    songIndex = songIndex,
                    title = song.title,
                    file = song.file
                )
            }
        }
    }

    private fun loadQueueIntoController(
        queue: List<QueueSong>,
        startIndex: Int,
        autoPlay: Boolean
    ) {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return
        if (queue.isEmpty()) return

        currentQueue = queue

        val mediaItems =
            queue.map { queueSong ->
                MediaItem.fromUri(r2Base + queueSong.file)
            }

        controller.stop()
        controller.clearMediaItems()
        controller.setMediaItems(mediaItems, startIndex, 0L)
        controller.repeatMode = repeatMode
        controller.prepare()

        updateNowPlayingFromController()

        if (autoPlay) {
            controller.play()
            playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
        } else {
            playPauseBtn.text = "Play"
        }
    }

    private fun loadAlbumIntoController(
        albumIndex: Int,
        autoPlay: Boolean
    ) {
        if (albumIndex < 0 || albumIndex >= MusicCatalog.albums.size) return

        val controller = mediaController ?: return

        isShuffleAllMode = false
        currentAlbumIndex = albumIndex
        currentSongIndex = 0

        controller.shuffleModeEnabled = false
        shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle"

        loadQueueIntoController(
            queue = makeAlbumQueue(albumIndex),
            startIndex = 0,
            autoPlay = autoPlay
        )
    }

    private fun loadAllSongsShuffle() {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return

        isShuffleAllMode = true

        controller.shuffleModeEnabled = true
        shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle All"

        loadQueueIntoController(
            queue = makeAllSongsQueue(),
            startIndex = 0,
            autoPlay = true
        )

        controller.shuffleModeEnabled = true
        albumsBtn.text = "All Albums"
        playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
    }

    private fun updateNowPlayingFromController() {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return
        val queueIndex = controller.currentMediaItemIndex

        if (queueIndex < 0 || queueIndex >= currentQueue.size) return

        val queueSong = currentQueue[queueIndex]

        currentAlbumIndex = queueSong.albumIndex
        currentSongIndex = queueSong.songIndex

        val albumTitle = MusicCatalog.albums[currentAlbumIndex].title

        albumsBtn.text =
            if (isShuffleAllMode) {
                "All Albums: $albumTitle"
            } else {
                albumTitle
            }
    }

    private fun setupButtons() {

        albumsBtn.setOnClickListener {
            showAlbumList()
        }

        songListBtn.setOnClickListener {
            showSongList()
        }

        prevBtn.setOnClickListener {
            mediaController?.seekToPreviousMediaItem()
        }

        nextBtn.setOnClickListener {
            mediaController?.seekToNextMediaItem()
        }

        playPauseBtn.setOnClickListener {
            val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

            if (controller.isPlaying) {
                controller.pause()
                playPauseBtn.text = "Play"
            } else {
                controller.play()
                playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
            }
        }

        shuffleBtn.setOnClickListener {
            val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

            if (!controller.shuffleModeEnabled && !isShuffleAllMode) {
                controller.shuffleModeEnabled = true
                shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle Album"
            } else if (controller.shuffleModeEnabled && !isShuffleAllMode) {
                loadAllSongsShuffle()
            } else {
                isShuffleAllMode = false
                controller.shuffleModeEnabled = false
                shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle"
                loadAlbumIntoController(currentAlbumIndex, autoPlay = false)
            }
        }

        repeatBtn.setOnClickListener {
            val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

            repeatMode =
                when (repeatMode) {
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_OFF -> Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL -> Player.REPEAT_MODE_ONE
                    else -> Player.REPEAT_MODE_OFF
                }

            controller.repeatMode = repeatMode

            repeatBtn.text =
                when (repeatMode) {
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL -> "Repeat All"
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_ONE -> "Repeat One"
                    else -> "Repeat Off"
                }
        }
    }

    private fun showAlbumList() {
        val albumTitles =
            MusicCatalog.albums.map { it.title }.toTypedArray()

        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle("Select Album")
            .setItems(albumTitles) { dialog, which ->
                loadAlbumIntoController(which, autoPlay = true)
                dialog.dismiss()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun showSongList() {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return
        val album = currentAlbum()

        val songTitles = album.songs.map { it.title }

        val adapter = object : ArrayAdapter<String>(
            this,
            android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1,
            songTitles
        ) {
            override fun getView(
                position: Int,
                convertView: View?,
                parent: ViewGroup
            ): View {
                val view =
                    super.getView(position, convertView, parent) as TextView

                val isCurrentSong =
                    position == currentSongIndex

                view.textSize = 16f
                view.setPadding(32, 24, 32, 24)

                if (isCurrentSong) {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 140, 40))
                    view.setShadowLayer(
                        18f,
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        Color.rgb(255, 90, 0)
                    )
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.argb(55, 255, 100, 0))
                    view.text = "▶  ${songTitles[position]}"
                } else {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 218, 200))
                    view.setShadowLayer(
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        Color.TRANSPARENT
                    )
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(18, 15, 14))
                    view.text = songTitles[position]
                }

                return view
            }
        }

        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle(
                if (isShuffleAllMode) {
                    "${album.title} — Current Song"
                } else {
                    album.title
                }
            )
            .setAdapter(adapter) { dialog, which ->
                isShuffleAllMode = false
                controller.shuffleModeEnabled = false
                shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle"

                currentAlbumIndex = currentAlbumIndex
                currentSongIndex = which

                loadQueueIntoController(
                    queue = makeAlbumQueue(currentAlbumIndex),
                    startIndex = which,
                    autoPlay = true
                )

                dialog.dismiss()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        mediaController?.release()
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    override fun onBackPressed() {
        if (webView.canGoBack()) {
            webView.goBack()
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            super.onBackPressed()
        }
    }
}
```

Yes — replace your full `MainActivity.kt` with this version. I only changed the album list section, keeping your current working script structure intact. fileciteturn2file0

```kotlin
package com.example.lokis_kingdom

import android.app.AlertDialog
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.webkit.WebChromeClient
import android.webkit.WebSettings
import android.webkit.WebView
import android.webkit.WebViewClient
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.media3.common.MediaItem
import androidx.media3.common.Player
import androidx.media3.session.MediaController
import androidx.media3.session.SessionToken
import com.google.common.util.concurrent.MoreExecutors

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var webView: WebView

    private lateinit var albumsBtn: Button
    private lateinit var songListBtn: Button
    private lateinit var prevBtn: Button
    private lateinit var playPauseBtn: Button
    private lateinit var nextBtn: Button
    private lateinit var shuffleBtn: Button
    private lateinit var repeatBtn: Button

    private var mediaController: MediaController? = null
    private var repeatMode = Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL

    private var currentAlbumIndex = 0
    private var currentSongIndex = 0
    private var isShuffleAllMode = false

    private data class QueueSong(
        val albumIndex: Int,
        val songIndex: Int,
        val title: String,
        val file: String
    )

    private var currentQueue: List<QueueSong> = emptyList()

    private val r2Base =
        "https://pub-4ae7f49887bc46e9a03de6e38886b609.r2.dev/"

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)

        webView = findViewById(R.id.webView)

        albumsBtn = findViewById(R.id.albumsBtn)
        songListBtn = findViewById(R.id.songListBtn)
        prevBtn = findViewById(R.id.prevBtn)
        playPauseBtn = findViewById(R.id.playPauseBtn)
        nextBtn = findViewById(R.id.nextBtn)
        shuffleBtn = findViewById(R.id.shuffleBtn)
        repeatBtn = findViewById(R.id.repeatBtn)

        webView.webViewClient = WebViewClient()
        webView.webChromeClient = WebChromeClient()

        val webSettings: WebSettings = webView.settings
        webSettings.javaScriptEnabled = true
        webSettings.domStorageEnabled = true
        webSettings.mediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture = true

        webView.loadUrl("https://lokiskingdom.com")

        webView.evaluateJavascript(
            """
            document.querySelectorAll('audio').forEach(a => {
                a.autoplay = false;
                a.pause();
            });
            """.trimIndent(),
            null
        )

        val sessionToken = SessionToken(
            this,
            android.content.ComponentName(
                this,
                MusicService::class.java
            )
        )

        val controllerFuture =
            MediaController.Builder(this, sessionToken)
                .buildAsync()

        controllerFuture.addListener({
            mediaController = controllerFuture.get()

            mediaController?.addListener(object : Player.Listener {
                override fun onMediaItemTransition(
                    mediaItem: MediaItem?,
                    reason: Int
                ) {
                    updateNowPlayingFromController()
                }

                override fun onIsPlayingChanged(isPlaying: Boolean) {
                    playPauseBtn.text = if (isPlaying) "Pause" else "Play"
                }
            })

            loadAlbumIntoController(0, autoPlay = false)
            setupButtons()
        }, MoreExecutors.directExecutor())
    }

    private fun currentAlbum(): Album {
        return MusicCatalog.albums[currentAlbumIndex]
    }

    private fun makeAlbumQueue(albumIndex: Int): List<QueueSong> {
        val album = MusicCatalog.albums[albumIndex]

        return album.songs.mapIndexed { songIndex, song ->
            QueueSong(
                albumIndex = albumIndex,
                songIndex = songIndex,
                title = song.title,
                file = song.file
            )
        }
    }

    private fun makeAllSongsQueue(): List<QueueSong> {
        return MusicCatalog.albums.flatMapIndexed { albumIndex, album ->
            album.songs.mapIndexed { songIndex, song ->
                QueueSong(
                    albumIndex = albumIndex,
                    songIndex = songIndex,
                    title = song.title,
                    file = song.file
                )
            }
        }
    }

    private fun loadQueueIntoController(
        queue: List<QueueSong>,
        startIndex: Int,
        autoPlay: Boolean
    ) {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return
        if (queue.isEmpty()) return

        currentQueue = queue

        val mediaItems =
            queue.map { queueSong ->
                MediaItem.fromUri(r2Base + queueSong.file)
            }

        controller.stop()
        controller.clearMediaItems()
        controller.setMediaItems(mediaItems, startIndex, 0L)
        controller.repeatMode = repeatMode
        controller.prepare()

        updateNowPlayingFromController()

        if (autoPlay) {
            controller.play()
            playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
        } else {
            playPauseBtn.text = "Play"
        }
    }

    private fun loadAlbumIntoController(
        albumIndex: Int,
        autoPlay: Boolean
    ) {
        if (albumIndex < 0 || albumIndex >= MusicCatalog.albums.size) return

        val controller = mediaController ?: return

        isShuffleAllMode = false
        currentAlbumIndex = albumIndex
        currentSongIndex = 0

        controller.shuffleModeEnabled = false
        shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle"

        loadQueueIntoController(
            queue = makeAlbumQueue(albumIndex),
            startIndex = 0,
            autoPlay = autoPlay
        )
    }

    private fun loadAllSongsShuffle() {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return

        isShuffleAllMode = true

        controller.shuffleModeEnabled = true
        shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle All"

        loadQueueIntoController(
            queue = makeAllSongsQueue(),
            startIndex = 0,
            autoPlay = true
        )

        controller.shuffleModeEnabled = true
        albumsBtn.text = "All Albums"
        playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
    }

    private fun updateNowPlayingFromController() {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return
        val queueIndex = controller.currentMediaItemIndex

        if (queueIndex < 0 || queueIndex >= currentQueue.size) return

        val queueSong = currentQueue[queueIndex]

        currentAlbumIndex = queueSong.albumIndex
        currentSongIndex = queueSong.songIndex

        val albumTitle = MusicCatalog.albums[currentAlbumIndex].title

        albumsBtn.text =
            if (isShuffleAllMode) {
                "All Albums: $albumTitle"
            } else {
                albumTitle
            }
    }

    private fun setupButtons() {

        albumsBtn.setOnClickListener {
            showAlbumList()
        }

        songListBtn.setOnClickListener {
            showSongList()
        }

        prevBtn.setOnClickListener {
            mediaController?.seekToPreviousMediaItem()
        }

        nextBtn.setOnClickListener {
            mediaController?.seekToNextMediaItem()
        }

        playPauseBtn.setOnClickListener {
            val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

            if (controller.isPlaying) {
                controller.pause()
                playPauseBtn.text = "Play"
            } else {
                controller.play()
                playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
            }
        }

        shuffleBtn.setOnClickListener {
            val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

            if (!controller.shuffleModeEnabled && !isShuffleAllMode) {
                controller.shuffleModeEnabled = true
                shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle Album"
            } else if (controller.shuffleModeEnabled && !isShuffleAllMode) {
                loadAllSongsShuffle()
            } else {
                isShuffleAllMode = false
                controller.shuffleModeEnabled = false
                shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle"
                loadAlbumIntoController(currentAlbumIndex, autoPlay = false)
            }
        }

        repeatBtn.setOnClickListener {
            val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

            repeatMode =
                when (repeatMode) {
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_OFF -> Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL -> Player.REPEAT_MODE_ONE
                    else -> Player.REPEAT_MODE_OFF
                }

            controller.repeatMode = repeatMode

            repeatBtn.text =
                when (repeatMode) {
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL -> "Repeat All"
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_ONE -> "Repeat One"
                    else -> "Repeat Off"
                }
        }
    }

    private fun showAlbumList() {
        val albumTitles =
            MusicCatalog.albums.map { it.title }

        val adapter = object : ArrayAdapter<String>(
            this,
            android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1,
            albumTitles
        ) {
            override fun getView(
                position: Int,
                convertView: View?,
                parent: ViewGroup
            ): View {
                val view =
                    super.getView(position, convertView, parent) as TextView

                val isCurrentAlbum =
                    position == currentAlbumIndex

                view.textSize = 16f
                view.setPadding(32, 24, 32, 24)

                if (isCurrentAlbum) {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 140, 40))
                    view.setShadowLayer(
                        18f,
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        Color.rgb(255, 90, 0)
                    )
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.argb(55, 255, 100, 0))
                    view.text = "▶  ${albumTitles[position]}"
                } else {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 218, 200))
                    view.setShadowLayer(
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        Color.TRANSPARENT
                    )
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(18, 15, 14))
                    view.text = albumTitles[position]
                }

                return view
            }
        }

        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle("Select Album")
            .setAdapter(adapter) { dialog, which ->
                loadAlbumIntoController(which, autoPlay = true)
                dialog.dismiss()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun showSongList() {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return
        val album = currentAlbum()

        val songTitles = album.songs.map { it.title }

        val adapter = object : ArrayAdapter<String>(
            this,
            android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1,
            songTitles
        ) {
            override fun getView(
                position: Int,
                convertView: View?,
                parent: ViewGroup
            ): View {
                val view =
                    super.getView(position, convertView, parent) as TextView

                val isCurrentSong =
                    position == currentSongIndex

                view.textSize = 16f
                view.setPadding(32, 24, 32, 24)

                if (isCurrentSong) {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 140, 40))
                    view.setShadowLayer(
```

user
agenda item: pulling out the headphones should pause playback.
ChatGPT
Good agenda item. That’s a very “real app” feature.

Android already provides this through the audio system. What you want is:
- wired headphones unplugged → pause playback
- Bluetooth disconnect → ideally also pause later

For now, wired unplug pause is easy and low-risk.

Later agenda item:
- register audio becoming noisy receiver

Conceptually:

```kotlin
AudioManager.ACTION_AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY
```

When triggered:

```kotlin
mediaController?.pause()
```

This is standard behavior used by music apps so audio doesn’t suddenly blast through phone speakers.

I’d classify it as:
- small implementation
- high polish value
- low architectural risk

So definitely worth adding, just not necessarily before the UI pass is finished.

ChatGPT
Yes, that’s worth doing immediately because it affects normal daily use.

Add these imports at the top:

```kotlin
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.IntentFilter
import android.media.AudioManager
```

Then inside your class, add this receiver:

```kotlin
private val becomingNoisyReceiver = object : BroadcastReceiver() {
    override fun onReceive(context: Context?, intent: Intent?) {

        if (intent?.action == AudioManager.ACTION_AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY) {

            mediaController?.pause()
            playPauseBtn.text = "Play"
        }
    }
}
```

Then inside `onCreate()`, after your WebView setup is fine, add:

```kotlin
registerReceiver(
    becomingNoisyReceiver,
    IntentFilter(AudioManager.ACTION_AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY)
)
```

Then in `onDestroy()` add BEFORE `super.onDestroy()`:

```kotlin
unregisterReceiver(becomingNoisyReceiver)
```

That’s it.

Now:
- unplug wired headphones → playback pauses
- many Bluetooth disconnects will also trigger it

Very high quality-of-life improvement for very little code.

```kotlin
import android.app.AlertDialog
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.IntentFilter
import android.graphics.Color
import android.media.AudioManager
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.webkit.WebChromeClient
import android.webkit.WebSettings
import android.webkit.WebView
import android.webkit.WebViewClient
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.media3.common.MediaItem
import androidx.media3.common.Player
import androidx.media3.session.MediaController
import androidx.media3.session.SessionToken
import com.google.common.util.concurrent.MoreExecutors

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var webView: WebView

    private lateinit var albumsBtn: Button
    private lateinit var songListBtn: Button
    private lateinit var prevBtn: Button
    private lateinit var playPauseBtn: Button
    private lateinit var nextBtn: Button
    private lateinit var shuffleBtn: Button
    private lateinit var repeatBtn: Button

    private var repeatMode = Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL

    private val becomingNoisyReceiver = object : BroadcastReceiver() {

            if (intent?.action == AudioManager.ACTION_AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY) {
                mediaController?.pause()
                playPauseBtn.text = "Play"
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)

        webView = findViewById(R.id.webView)

        albumsBtn = findViewById(R.id.albumsBtn)
        songListBtn = findViewById(R.id.songListBtn)
        prevBtn = findViewById(R.id.prevBtn)
        playPauseBtn = findViewById(R.id.playPauseBtn)
        nextBtn = findViewById(R.id.nextBtn)
        shuffleBtn = findViewById(R.id.shuffleBtn)
        repeatBtn = findViewById(R.id.repeatBtn)

        registerReceiver(
            becomingNoisyReceiver,
            IntentFilter(AudioManager.ACTION_AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY)
        )

        webView.webViewClient = WebViewClient()
        webView.webChromeClient = WebChromeClient()

        val webSettings: WebSettings = webView.settings
        webSettings.javaScriptEnabled = true
        webSettings.domStorageEnabled = true
        webSettings.mediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture = true

        webView.loadUrl("https://lokiskingdom.com")

        webView.evaluateJavascript(
            """
            document.querySelectorAll('audio').forEach(a => {
                a.autoplay = false;
                a.pause();
            });
            """.trimIndent(),
            null
        )

        val sessionToken = SessionToken(
            this,
            android.content.ComponentName(
                this,
                MusicService::class.java
            )
        )

        val controllerFuture =
            MediaController.Builder(this, sessionToken)
                .buildAsync()

        controllerFuture.addListener({
            mediaController = controllerFuture.get()

            mediaController?.addListener(object : Player.Listener {
                override fun onMediaItemTransition(
                    mediaItem: MediaItem?,
                    reason: Int
                ) {
                    updateNowPlayingFromController()
                }

                override fun onIsPlayingChanged(isPlaying: Boolean) {
                    playPauseBtn.text = if (isPlaying) "Pause" else "Play"
                }
            })

            loadAlbumIntoController(0, autoPlay = false)
            setupButtons()
        }, MoreExecutors.directExecutor())
    }

    private fun currentAlbum(): Album {
        return MusicCatalog.albums[currentAlbumIndex]
    }

    private fun makeAlbumQueue(albumIndex: Int): List<QueueSong> {
        val album = MusicCatalog.albums[albumIndex]

        return album.songs.mapIndexed { songIndex, song ->
            QueueSong(
                albumIndex = albumIndex,
                songIndex = songIndex,
                title = song.title,
                file = song.file
            )
        }
    }

    private fun makeAllSongsQueue(): List<QueueSong> {
        return MusicCatalog.albums.flatMapIndexed { albumIndex, album ->
            album.songs.mapIndexed { songIndex, song ->
                QueueSong(
                    albumIndex = albumIndex,
                    songIndex = songIndex,
                    title = song.title,
                    file = song.file
                )
            }
        }
    }

    private fun loadQueueIntoController(
        queue: List<QueueSong>,
        startIndex: Int,
        autoPlay: Boolean
    ) {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return
        if (queue.isEmpty()) return

        currentQueue = queue

        val mediaItems =
            queue.map { queueSong ->
                MediaItem.fromUri(r2Base + queueSong.file)
            }

        controller.stop()
        controller.clearMediaItems()
        controller.setMediaItems(mediaItems, startIndex, 0L)
        controller.repeatMode = repeatMode
        controller.prepare()

        updateNowPlayingFromController()

        if (autoPlay) {
            controller.play()
            playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
        } else {
            playPauseBtn.text = "Play"
        }
    }

    private fun loadAlbumIntoController(
        albumIndex: Int,
        autoPlay: Boolean
    ) {
        if (albumIndex < 0 || albumIndex >= MusicCatalog.albums.size) return

        val controller = mediaController ?: return

        isShuffleAllMode = false
        currentAlbumIndex = albumIndex
        currentSongIndex = 0

        controller.shuffleModeEnabled = false
        shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle"

        loadQueueIntoController(
            queue = makeAlbumQueue(albumIndex),
            startIndex = 0,
            autoPlay = autoPlay
        )
    }

    private fun loadAllSongsShuffle() {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return

        isShuffleAllMode = true

        controller.shuffleModeEnabled = true
        shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle All"

        loadQueueIntoController(
            queue = makeAllSongsQueue(),
            startIndex = 0,
            autoPlay = true
        )

        controller.shuffleModeEnabled = true
        albumsBtn.text = "All Albums"
        playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
    }

    private fun updateNowPlayingFromController() {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return
        val queueIndex = controller.currentMediaItemIndex

        if (queueIndex < 0 || queueIndex >= currentQueue.size) return

        val queueSong = currentQueue[queueIndex]

        currentAlbumIndex = queueSong.albumIndex
        currentSongIndex = queueSong.songIndex

        val albumTitle = MusicCatalog.albums[currentAlbumIndex].title

        albumsBtn.text =
            if (isShuffleAllMode) {
                "All Albums: $albumTitle"
            } else {
                albumTitle
            }
    }

    private fun setupButtons() {

        albumsBtn.setOnClickListener {
            showAlbumList()
        }

        songListBtn.setOnClickListener {
            showSongList()
        }

        prevBtn.setOnClickListener {
            mediaController?.seekToPreviousMediaItem()
        }

        nextBtn.setOnClickListener {
            mediaController?.seekToNextMediaItem()
        }

        playPauseBtn.setOnClickListener {
            val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

            if (controller.isPlaying) {
                controller.pause()
                playPauseBtn.text = "Play"
            } else {
                controller.play()
                playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
            }
        }

        shuffleBtn.setOnClickListener {
            val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

            if (!controller.shuffleModeEnabled && !isShuffleAllMode) {
                controller.shuffleModeEnabled = true
                shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle Album"
            } else if (controller.shuffleModeEnabled && !isShuffleAllMode) {
                loadAllSongsShuffle()
            } else {
                isShuffleAllMode = false
                controller.shuffleModeEnabled = false
                shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle"
                loadAlbumIntoController(currentAlbumIndex, autoPlay = false)
            }
        }

        repeatBtn.setOnClickListener {
            val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

            repeatMode =
                when (repeatMode) {
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_OFF -> Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL -> Player.REPEAT_MODE_ONE
                    else -> Player.REPEAT_MODE_OFF
                }

            controller.repeatMode = repeatMode

            repeatBtn.text =
                when (repeatMode) {
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL -> "Repeat All"
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_ONE -> "Repeat One"
                    else -> "Repeat Off"
                }
        }
    }

    private fun showAlbumList() {
        val albumTitles =
            MusicCatalog.albums.map { it.title }

        val adapter = object : ArrayAdapter<String>(
            this,
            android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1,
            albumTitles
        ) {
            override fun getView(
                position: Int,
                convertView: View?,
                parent: ViewGroup
            ): View {
                val view =
                    super.getView(position, convertView, parent) as TextView

                val isCurrentAlbum =
                    position == currentAlbumIndex

                view.textSize = 16f
                view.setPadding(32, 24, 32, 24)

                if (isCurrentAlbum) {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 140, 40))
                    view.setShadowLayer(
                        18f,
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        Color.rgb(255, 90, 0)
                    )
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.argb(55, 255, 100, 0))
                    view.text = "▶  ${albumTitles[position]}"
                } else {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 218, 200))
                    view.setShadowLayer(
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        Color.TRANSPARENT
                    )
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(18, 15, 14))
                    view.text = albumTitles[position]
                }

                return view
            }
        }

        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle("Select Album")
            .setAdapter(adapter) { dialog, which ->
                loadAlbumIntoController(which, autoPlay = true)
                dialog.dismiss()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun showSongList() {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return
        val album = currentAlbum()

        val songTitles = album.songs.map { it.title }

        val adapter = object : ArrayAdapter<String>(
            this,
            android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1,
            songTitles
        ) {
            override fun getView(
                position: Int,
                convertView: View?,
                parent: ViewGroup
            ): View {
                val view =
                    super.getView(position, convertView, parent) as TextView

                val isCurrentSong =
                    position == currentSongIndex

                view.textSize = 16f
                view.setPadding(32, 24, 32, 24)

                if (isCurrentSong) {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 140, 40))
                    view.setShadowLayer(
                        18f,
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        Color.rgb(255, 90, 0)
                    )
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.argb(55, 255, 100, 0))
                    view.text = "▶  ${songTitles[position]}"
                } else {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 218, 200))
                    view.setShadowLayer(
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        Color.TRANSPARENT
                    )
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(18, 15, 14))
                    view.text = songTitles[position]
                }

                return view
            }
        }

        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle(
                if (isShuffleAllMode) {
                    "${album.title} — Current Song"
                } else {
                    album.title
                }
            )
            .setAdapter(adapter) { dialog, which ->
                isShuffleAllMode = false
                controller.shuffleModeEnabled = false
                shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle"

                currentSongIndex = which

                loadQueueIntoController(
                    queue = makeAlbumQueue(currentAlbumIndex),
                    startIndex = which,
                    autoPlay = true
                )

                dialog.dismiss()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        unregisterReceiver(becomingNoisyReceiver)
        mediaController?.release()
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    override fun onBackPressed() {
        if (webView.canGoBack()) {
            webView.goBack()
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            super.onBackPressed()
        }
    }
}
```

user
atmospheric UI polish, that will make everything look cool and orange? there should also be reds maybe, though that might detract from the appeal of that orange glow..... hmm.....
ChatGPT
You’re thinking about it correctly already: the glow only works if the palette around it is restrained.

If *everything* becomes bright red/orange, then:
- nothing stands out
- the glow loses meaning
- the UI starts looking noisy or “gamer RGB”

The strongest version of this aesthetic is probably:

- mostly charcoal black
- dark iron gray
- deep brown-black
- muted ember reds
- then the vivid orange reserved for:
  - currently playing items
  - hover states
  - active controls
  - important highlights

So red should exist mostly as:
- undertones
- gradients
- subtle accents
- background warmth

—not primary UI elements.

Think:
- furnace room
- cathedral embers
- torchlight
- old iron
- ash
- volcanic glow

rather than:
- neon cyberpunk
- solid red everywhere

The orange glow works *because* the rest of the interface is subdued.

A very strong setup would be:

```text
Background:
near-black charcoal

Panels:
dark iron / dark brown

Normal text:
warm parchment gray

Inactive buttons:
muted dark metal

Current song/current album:
bright ember orange glow

Danger/accent states:
deep crimson
```

So yes:
- use some reds
- but sparingly
- mainly atmospheric
- let orange remain the “living fire” color

That restraint is what makes interfaces feel expensive and intentional instead of cluttered.

```kotlin
private fun applyAtmosphericUi() {
    val background = Color.rgb(10, 8, 7)
    val panel = Color.rgb(24, 18, 15)
    val ember = Color.rgb(255, 122, 24)
    val emberDark = Color.rgb(120, 42, 12)
    val parchment = Color.rgb(230, 218, 200)

    window.statusBarColor = background
    window.navigationBarColor = background

    findViewById<View>(android.R.id.content).setBackgroundColor(background)

    val buttons = listOf(
        albumsBtn,
        songListBtn,
        prevBtn,
        playPauseBtn,
        nextBtn,
        shuffleBtn,
        repeatBtn
    )

    buttons.forEach { button ->
        button.setTextColor(parchment)
        button.textSize = 13f
        button.typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
        button.backgroundTintList = ColorStateList.valueOf(panel)
        button.setShadowLayer(8f, 0f, 0f, emberDark)
        button.setPadding(10, 8, 10, 8)
    }

    playPauseBtn.setTextColor(ember)
    playPauseBtn.setShadowLayer(14f, 0f, 0f, ember)

    albumsBtn.setTextColor(ember)
    albumsBtn.setShadowLayer(12f, 0f, 0f, emberDark)
}
```

This should give you the first pass of the dark iron / ember UI without risking the app structure. The glowing list items stay the strongest orange, while the main controls get the darker atmospheric treatment.

```kotlin
                    view.text = albumTitles[position]
                }

                return view
            }
        }

        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle("Select Album")
            .setAdapter(adapter) { dialog, which ->
                loadAlbumIntoController(which, autoPlay = true)
                dialog.dismiss()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun showSongList() {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return
        val album = currentAlbum()

        val songTitles = album.songs.map { it.title }

        val adapter = object : ArrayAdapter<String>(
            this,
            android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1,
            songTitles
        ) {
            override fun getView(
                position: Int,
                convertView: View?,
                parent: ViewGroup
            ): View {
                val view =
                    super.getView(position, convertView, parent) as TextView

                val isCurrentSong =
                    position == currentSongIndex

                view.textSize = 16f
                view.setPadding(32, 24, 32, 24)

                if (isCurrentSong) {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 140, 40))
                    view.setShadowLayer(
                        18f,
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        Color.rgb(255, 90, 0)
                    )
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.argb(55, 255, 100, 0))
                    view.text = "▶  ${songTitles[position]}"
                } else {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 218, 200))
                    view.setShadowLayer(
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        0f,
                        Color.TRANSPARENT
                    )
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(18, 15, 14))
                    view.text = songTitles[position]
                }

                return view
            }
        }

        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle(
                if (isShuffleAllMode) {
                    "${album.title} — Current Song"
                } else {
                    album.title
                }
            )
            .setAdapter(adapter) { dialog, which ->
                isShuffleAllMode = false
                controller.shuffleModeEnabled = false
                shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle"

                currentSongIndex = which

                loadQueueIntoController(
                    queue = makeAlbumQueue(currentAlbumIndex),
                    startIndex = which,
                    autoPlay = true
                )

                dialog.dismiss()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        unregisterReceiver(becomingNoisyReceiver)
        mediaController?.release()
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    override fun onBackPressed() {
        if (webView.canGoBack()) {
            webView.goBack()
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            super.onBackPressed()
        }
    }
}
```

ok, please provide the script
ChatGPT
Yes — I’ll give you the full `MainActivity.kt` with the animation polish included cleanly: button press scale + subtle fade-in for album/song list rows.

```kotlin
package com.example.lokis_kingdom

import android.animation.ObjectAnimator
import android.app.AlertDialog
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.IntentFilter
import android.content.res.ColorStateList
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.media.AudioManager
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator
import android.webkit.WebChromeClient
import android.webkit.WebSettings
import android.webkit.WebView
import android.webkit.WebViewClient
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.media3.common.MediaItem
import androidx.media3.common.Player
import androidx.media3.session.MediaController
import androidx.media3.session.SessionToken
import com.google.common.util.concurrent.MoreExecutors

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var webView: WebView

    private lateinit var albumsBtn: Button
    private lateinit var songListBtn: Button
    private lateinit var prevBtn: Button
    private lateinit var playPauseBtn: Button
    private lateinit var nextBtn: Button
    private lateinit var shuffleBtn: Button
    private lateinit var repeatBtn: Button

    private var mediaController: MediaController? = null
    private var repeatMode = Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL

    private var currentAlbumIndex = 0
    private var currentSongIndex = 0
    private var isShuffleAllMode = false

    private data class QueueSong(
        val albumIndex: Int,
        val songIndex: Int,
        val title: String,
        val file: String
    )

    private var currentQueue: List<QueueSong> = emptyList()

    private val r2Base =
        "https://pub-4ae7f49887bc46e9a03de6e38886b609.r2.dev/"

    private val becomingNoisyReceiver = object : BroadcastReceiver() {
        override fun onReceive(context: Context?, intent: Intent?) {
            if (intent?.action == AudioManager.ACTION_AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY) {
                mediaController?.pause()
                playPauseBtn.text = "Play"
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)

        webView = findViewById(R.id.webView)

        albumsBtn = findViewById(R.id.albumsBtn)
        songListBtn = findViewById(R.id.songListBtn)
        prevBtn = findViewById(R.id.prevBtn)
        playPauseBtn = findViewById(R.id.playPauseBtn)
        nextBtn = findViewById(R.id.nextBtn)
        shuffleBtn = findViewById(R.id.shuffleBtn)
        repeatBtn = findViewById(R.id.repeatBtn)

        applyAtmosphericUi()

        registerReceiver(
            becomingNoisyReceiver,
            IntentFilter(AudioManager.ACTION_AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY)
        )

        webView.webViewClient = WebViewClient()
        webView.webChromeClient = WebChromeClient()

        val webSettings: WebSettings = webView.settings
        webSettings.javaScriptEnabled = true
        webSettings.domStorageEnabled = true
        webSettings.mediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture = true

        webView.loadUrl("https://lokiskingdom.com")

        webView.evaluateJavascript(
            """
            document.querySelectorAll('audio').forEach(a => {
                a.autoplay = false;
                a.pause();
            });
            """.trimIndent(),
            null
        )

        val sessionToken = SessionToken(
            this,
            android.content.ComponentName(
                this,
                MusicService::class.java
            )
        )

        val controllerFuture =
            MediaController.Builder(this, sessionToken)
                .buildAsync()

        controllerFuture.addListener({
            mediaController = controllerFuture.get()

            mediaController?.addListener(object : Player.Listener {
                override fun onMediaItemTransition(
                    mediaItem: MediaItem?,
                    reason: Int
                ) {
                    updateNowPlayingFromController()
                }

                override fun onIsPlayingChanged(isPlaying: Boolean) {
                    playPauseBtn.text = if (isPlaying) "Pause" else "Play"
                }
            })

            loadAlbumIntoController(0, autoPlay = false)
            setupButtons()
        }, MoreExecutors.directExecutor())
    }

    private fun applyAtmosphericUi() {
        val background = Color.rgb(10, 8, 7)
        val panel = Color.rgb(24, 18, 15)
        val ember = Color.rgb(255, 122, 24)
        val emberDark = Color.rgb(120, 42, 12)
        val parchment = Color.rgb(230, 218, 200)

        window.statusBarColor = background
        window.navigationBarColor = background

        findViewById<View>(android.R.id.content).setBackgroundColor(background)

        val buttons = listOf(
            albumsBtn,
            songListBtn,
            prevBtn,
            playPauseBtn,
            nextBtn,
            shuffleBtn,
            repeatBtn
        )

        buttons.forEach { button ->
            button.setTextColor(parchment)
            button.textSize = 13f
            button.typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
            button.backgroundTintList = ColorStateList.valueOf(panel)
            button.setShadowLayer(8f, 0f, 0f, emberDark)
            button.setPadding(10, 8, 10, 8)
            addButtonPressAnimation(button)
        }

        playPauseBtn.setTextColor(ember)
        playPauseBtn.setShadowLayer(14f, 0f, 0f, ember)

        albumsBtn.setTextColor(ember)
        albumsBtn.setShadowLayer(12f, 0f, 0f, emberDark)
    }

    private fun addButtonPressAnimation(button: Button) {
        button.setOnTouchListener { view, event ->
            when (event.action) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    view.animate()
                        .scaleX(0.96f)
                        .scaleY(0.96f)
                        .setDuration(80)
                        .start()
                }

                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP,
                MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                    view.animate()
                        .scaleX(1f)
                        .scaleY(1f)
                        .setDuration(120)
                        .start()
                }
            }
            false
        }
    }

    private fun animateListRow(view: View, position: Int) {
        view.alpha = 0f
        view.translationY = 12f

        view.animate()
            .alpha(1f)
            .translationY(0f)
            .setStartDelay((position * 20L).coerceAtMost(160L))
            .setDuration(180)
            .setInterpolator(DecelerateInterpolator())
            .start()
    }

    private fun currentAlbum(): Album {
        return MusicCatalog.albums[currentAlbumIndex]
    }

    private fun makeAlbumQueue(albumIndex: Int): List<QueueSong> {
        val album = MusicCatalog.albums[albumIndex]

        return album.songs.mapIndexed { songIndex, song ->
            QueueSong(albumIndex, songIndex, song.title, song.file)
        }
    }

    private fun makeAllSongsQueue(): List<QueueSong> {
        return MusicCatalog.albums.flatMapIndexed { albumIndex, album ->
            album.songs.mapIndexed { songIndex, song ->
                QueueSong(albumIndex, songIndex, song.title, song.file)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun loadQueueIntoController(
        queue: List<QueueSong>,
        startIndex: Int,
        autoPlay: Boolean
    ) {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return
        if (queue.isEmpty()) return

        currentQueue = queue

        val mediaItems = queue.map {
            MediaItem.fromUri(r2Base + it.file)
        }

        controller.stop()
        controller.clearMediaItems()
        controller.setMediaItems(mediaItems, startIndex, 0L)
        controller.repeatMode = repeatMode
        controller.prepare()

        updateNowPlayingFromController()

        if (autoPlay) {
            controller.play()
            playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
        } else {
            playPauseBtn.text = "Play"
        }
    }

    private fun loadAlbumIntoController(albumIndex: Int, autoPlay: Boolean) {
        if (albumIndex < 0 || albumIndex >= MusicCatalog.albums.size) return

        val controller = mediaController ?: return

        isShuffleAllMode = false
        currentAlbumIndex = albumIndex
        currentSongIndex = 0

        controller.shuffleModeEnabled = false
        shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle"

        loadQueueIntoController(
            queue = makeAlbumQueue(albumIndex),
            startIndex = 0,
            autoPlay = autoPlay
        )
    }

    private fun loadAllSongsShuffle() {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return

        isShuffleAllMode = true
        controller.shuffleModeEnabled = true
        shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle All"

        loadQueueIntoController(
            queue = makeAllSongsQueue(),
            startIndex = 0,
            autoPlay = true
        )

        controller.shuffleModeEnabled = true
        albumsBtn.text = "All Albums"
        playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
    }

    private fun updateNowPlayingFromController() {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return
        val queueIndex = controller.currentMediaItemIndex

        if (queueIndex < 0 || queueIndex >= currentQueue.size) return

        val queueSong = currentQueue[queueIndex]

        currentAlbumIndex = queueSong.albumIndex
        currentSongIndex = queueSong.songIndex

        val albumTitle = MusicCatalog.albums[currentAlbumIndex].title

        albumsBtn.text =
            if (isShuffleAllMode) {
                "All Albums: $albumTitle"
            } else {
                albumTitle
            }
    }

    private fun setupButtons() {
        albumsBtn.setOnClickListener { showAlbumList() }
        songListBtn.setOnClickListener { showSongList() }

        prevBtn.setOnClickListener {
            mediaController?.seekToPreviousMediaItem()
        }

        nextBtn.setOnClickListener {
            mediaController?.seekToNextMediaItem()
        }

        playPauseBtn.setOnClickListener {
            val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

            if (controller.isPlaying) {
                controller.pause()
                playPauseBtn.text = "Play"
            } else {
                controller.play()
                playPauseBtn.text = "Pause"
            }
        }

        shuffleBtn.setOnClickListener {
            val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

            if (!controller.shuffleModeEnabled && !isShuffleAllMode) {
                controller.shuffleModeEnabled = true
                shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle Album"
            } else if (controller.shuffleModeEnabled && !isShuffleAllMode) {
                loadAllSongsShuffle()
            } else {
                isShuffleAllMode = false
                controller.shuffleModeEnabled = false
                shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle"
                loadAlbumIntoController(currentAlbumIndex, autoPlay = false)
            }
        }

        repeatBtn.setOnClickListener {
            val controller = mediaController ?: return@setOnClickListener

            repeatMode =
                when (repeatMode) {
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_OFF -> Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL -> Player.REPEAT_MODE_ONE
                    else -> Player.REPEAT_MODE_OFF
                }

            controller.repeatMode = repeatMode

            repeatBtn.text =
                when (repeatMode) {
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_ALL -> "Repeat All"
                    Player.REPEAT_MODE_ONE -> "Repeat One"
                    else -> "Repeat Off"
                }
        }
    }

    private fun showAlbumList() {
        val albumTitles = MusicCatalog.albums.map { it.title }

        val adapter = object : ArrayAdapter<String>(
            this,
            android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1,
            albumTitles
        ) {
            override fun getView(position: Int, convertView: View?, parent: ViewGroup): View {
                val view = super.getView(position, convertView, parent) as TextView
                val isCurrentAlbum = position == currentAlbumIndex

                view.textSize = 16f
                view.setPadding(32, 24, 32, 24)

                if (isCurrentAlbum) {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 140, 40))
                    view.setShadowLayer(18f, 0f, 0f, Color.rgb(255, 90, 0))
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.argb(55, 255, 100, 0))
                    view.text = "▶  ${albumTitles[position]}"
                } else {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 218, 200))
                    view.setShadowLayer(0f, 0f, 0f, Color.TRANSPARENT)
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(18, 15, 14))
                    view.text = albumTitles[position]
                }

                animateListRow(view, position)
                return view
            }
        }

        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle("Select Album")
            .setAdapter(adapter) { dialog, which ->
                loadAlbumIntoController(which, autoPlay = true)
                dialog.dismiss()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun showSongList() {
        val controller = mediaController ?: return
        val album = currentAlbum()
        val songTitles = album.songs.map { it.title }

        val adapter = object : ArrayAdapter<String>(
            this,
            android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1,
            songTitles
        ) {
            override fun getView(position: Int, convertView: View?, parent: ViewGroup): View {
                val view = super.getView(position, convertView, parent) as TextView
                val isCurrentSong = position == currentSongIndex

                view.textSize = 16f
                view.setPadding(32, 24, 32, 24)

                if (isCurrentSong) {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(255, 140, 40))
                    view.setShadowLayer(18f, 0f, 0f, Color.rgb(255, 90, 0))
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.argb(55, 255, 100, 0))
                    view.text = "▶  ${songTitles[position]}"
                } else {
                    view.setTextColor(Color.rgb(230, 218, 200))
                    view.setShadowLayer(0f, 0f, 0f, Color.TRANSPARENT)
                    view.setBackgroundColor(Color.rgb(18, 15, 14))
                    view.text = songTitles[position]
                }

                animateListRow(view, position)
                return view
            }
        }

        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle(
                if (isShuffleAllMode) {
                    "${album.title} — Current Song"
                } else {
                    album.title
                }
            )
            .setAdapter(adapter) { dialog, which ->
                isShuffleAllMode = false
                controller.shuffleModeEnabled = false
                shuffleBtn.text = "Shuffle"

                currentSongIndex = which

                loadQueueIntoController(
                    queue = makeAlbumQueue(currentAlbumIndex),
                    startIndex = which,
                    autoPlay = true
                )

                dialog.dismiss()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        unregisterReceiver(becomingNoisyReceiver)
        mediaController?.release()
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    override fun onBackPressed() {
        if (webView.canGoBack()) {
            webView.goBack()
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            super.onBackPressed()
        }
    }
}
```

That actually increases the mystique rather than weakening it.

what's the location of the app i just created, it creates one every time, right? unless set to off i assume
ChatGPT
Yes — Android Studio is creating a new APK build each time you build/install unless you explicitly clean or overwrite it.

The most common locations are:

```text
YOUR_PROJECT/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/
```

Inside there you’ll usually find:

```text
app-debug.apk
```

Or for release builds:

```text
YOUR_PROJECT/app/build/outputs/apk/release/
```

with:

```text
app-release.apk
```

In your case probably something like:

```text
...\lokis-kingdom\loki\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\
```

You can also get to it directly from Android Studio:

```text
Build
→ Build Bundle(s) / APK(s)
→ Build APK(s)
```

Then a popup appears:

```text
APK(s) generated successfully
Locate
```

Clicking `Locate` opens the exact folder.

Now:
- Android Studio does overwrite `app-debug.apk`
- but Windows/your phone may still have older installed versions cached
- and if you manually renamed APKs, you may have several

So technically:
- yes, each build produces a new build artifact
- but usually under the same filename unless you configure versioned outputs later

Eventually you’ll want:
```kotlin
versionCode
versionName
```

incrementing properly, so:
- updates install cleanly
- Android recognizes newer versions
- users don’t get signature/version conflicts.
